tips.text: Join a big established clan, replicate the blueprint at the Chem Lab for 20,000 credits, and leave; it stays yours.
Rank your clan up freely; Rank is accumulated affinity and costs nothing, and only Tier raises research costs.
Start ranking the clan early; each rank-up needs a 72-hour Ascension Ceremony, so Rank 10 takes about a month.
In a developed clan it is a 20,000-credit purchase and a one-day build; the clan is the only real hurdle.
